subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.**

Qualifying for JEE Advanced has given Abhikriti __a shot in the arm__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. "A boost or stimulant".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence talks about the qualifying for the JEE Advanced examination has given Abhikriti a significant boost in confidence and motivation. 
 
• The meaning of the idiom **"a shot in the arm"** is **a boost, encouragement, or stimulus**. (एक बढ़ावा, प्रोत्साहन, या प्रोत्साहन)
 
 
• **For example:** The win at the soccer match was a shot in the arm for Tim. It made him very happy.
 
 
 
• The other options are not the correct meaning of the underlined idiom.

Hence the correct answer is **"A boost or stimulant".**
